name: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art
description: SANAA's circular glass museum in central Kanazawa, famous for the walkable 'Swimming Pool' installation and its free-entry public zone.
notes: Admission varies by exhibition; the pool installation is a paid area. In the Kanazawa city center.
